host = "localhost"

unquoted integer. Both fields are required; additional fields are ignored.

    def run_cli(self, content):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:

            path.write_text(content, encoding='utf-8')

    def test_toml_through_public_cli(self):

from dependency_fixture import dependencies


class DependenciesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_preserves_names_order_and_duplicates(self):
        record = {"dependencies": ["parser", "renderer", "parser"]}

        self.assertEqual(dependencies(record), ["parser", "renderer", "parser"])

    def test_returns_independent_list_without_changing_record(self):
        record = {"dependencies": ["parser"]}

        first = dependencies(record)
        second = dependencies(record)
        first.append("renderer")

        self.assertEqual(record, {"dependencies": ["parser"]})
        self.assertEqual(second, ["parser"])
        self.assertIsNot(first, record["dependencies"])
        self.assertIsNot(first, second)

    def test_missing_and_empty_dependencies_return_fresh_empty_lists(self):
        for record in ({}, {"dependencies": []}):
            with self.subTest(record=record):
                first = dependencies(record)
                second = dependencies(record)
                self.assertEqual(first, [])
                self.assertIsNot(first, second)
                first.append("parser")
                self.assertEqual(second, [])
                self.assertEqual(record.get("dependencies", []), [])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
